dynamic_route_groups.name: api3-generic-collections
dynamic_route_groups.risk: Collection names and route prefixes are assembled at runtime. The generator reads the locked enabledCollections setting and expands the reviewed templates only while the registration source hash is locked and their method, suffix, and handler source exactly match collection.js.

routes.auth_note: Deduplicating POST may additionally require api:{collection}:update.
Collection history includes tombstones and requires api:{collection}:read.
Collection history includes tombstones and requires api:{collection}:read.
Conditional upsert: an existing document requires api:{collection}:update; when no existing document matches the identifier, the insert branch requires api:{collection}:create.

v3 GET /api/v3/settings.note: The locked API3 settings search branch requires api:settings:admin.

v3 GET /api/v3/settings/history.note: The locked API3 settings history branch requires api:settings:admin; ordinary collection history remains read-protected.

v3 GET /api/v3/settings/history/:lastMod.note: The locked API3 settings history branch requires api:settings:admin; ordinary collection history remains read-protected.

v1 GET /api/v1/verifyauth.note: The route reports the permissions resolved from optional request credentials.

v2 GET /api/v2/verifyauth.note: Inherited from API v1; the route reports the permissions resolved from optional request credentials.

v1 GET /api/v1/adminnotifies.note: Anonymous callers receive the count; notification contents are filtered to full admins.

v2 GET /api/v2/adminnotifies.note: Inherited from API v1; notification contents are filtered to full admins.

v2 GET /api/v2/authorization/request/:ac.note: The access token is supplied as a path parameter and exchanged for authorization data/JWT state.

v2 GET /api/v2/authorization/debug/check.note: Development/debug endpoint; the required permission is read from the path.

v3 GET /api/v3/version.note: API v3 version information is public.

v3 GET /api/v3/test.note: Registered only in development, test, or CI environments.

v3 GET /api/v3/lastModified.note: Only readable collections are included in the response.

v3 GET /api/v3/status.note: Authentication is mandatory; the response derives per-collection permissions from the JWT.

v3 ALL /api/v3/swagger-ui-dist/*.note: Public prefix redirect to the API v3 documentation UI.
